formal: A close friend has asked to borrow £4,000 for their new business, which represents approximately one third of my savings. The intention is to transfer the money this week on the basis of a handshake, with nothing recorded in writing. It is unusual for me to consult you regarding decisions about my savings, and I rarely do so. I am unable to judge whether one third of my savings should be given out, so I shall proceed with the arrangement without having reached a decision. What is your view?
